opportunities.name: Kayak hotel search with guests, filters and price sort
opportunities.description: Search Kayak hotels for a {destination} from {check_in} to {check_out} for {guests}, optionally apply filters, and sort by price low to high.
steps: Click 'Search for hotels'
Type the destination in the location box and pick the matching suggestion
Pick check-in date and check-out date in the calendar
Set rooms/guests with the Increment buttons (and child ages if needed)
Click Search
Optionally apply filters (rating, stars, amenities, style)
Open the sort menu and choose 'Price (low to high)'

instances.values: Le Marais, Paris; 27th–2nd; +2 guests; sorted by price low to high
Kashi Vishwanath Temple, Varanasi; 6–10; +3 guests incl. child age 7; rating 8+, 3 stars, free internet, family, air-conditioned; price low to high

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways flight search and fare selection
opportunities.description: Search Qatar Airways flights from {origin} to {destination} on {date} for {passengers}/{cabin}, then select the fare.
steps: Optionally pick the destination from Explore > region > city > Discover
Type the origin in 'From' and pick the suggestion
Type the destination in 'To' and pick the suggestion (if not already filled in)
Open the depart date picker and choose the date, then click Continue
Open Passengers / Class, adjust adults/children/infants and cabin class, then click Confirm
Click 'Show flights'
Pick a flight price and click 'Select fare' (for each leg)

instances.values: Colombo → New York; 24 June 2023; +1 child, -1 infant; Business/First; selected LKR 1,120,521 and LKR 3,125,932 fares
Doha → Durban (picked via Explore > Africa); 28 May 2023; +1 infant; selected QAR 4,980 fare

opportunities.name: Qatar Airways hotel search
opportunities.description: Search hotels through Qatar Airways for a {destination} from {check_in} to {check_out}, then sort by price or pick a hotel.
steps: Click 'Book' and then the 'Hotels' link
Type the destination and pick the suggestion
Pick check-in and check-out dates
Click Search
Optionally adjust adults/children/rooms and click Done
Sort by 'Price (lowest first)' or apply filters
Optionally open a hotel with 'See availability' and click Reserve

instances.values: Las Vegas, NV; 10–16 April 2023; sorted by price, lowest first
Washington, DC; 5 June 2023 (flexible by 1 day); guests changed; filters applied; reserved a hotel
